support.quote: Promotional 0% intro APR applies for 15 billing cycles from account opening on balance transfers requested within 60 days of account creation. A balance transfer fee of 3% or $10 (whichever is greater) applies to each transfer. Standard balance transfer APR ranges from 18.24% to 28.24% variable based on creditworthiness after the intro period ends. Transfers cannot be made between existing Apex accounts.

Standard balance transfer requests take 5 to 7 business days to process and pay out to external card issuers. Expedited transfers are not available. Payments to external accounts continue to be the cardholder's responsibility until the transferred amount appears on the Apex credit statement.

query: For an Apex Platinum billing dispute, what deadline and documentation apply and when is provisional credit issued or revoked?
annotation_method: source-reviewed by Apex-03; independent challenge set, no gold_response used
annotator: Apex-03 AI source review (human confirmation pending)

support.quote: Cardholders may dispute a merchant transaction for billing errors, non-delivery of goods, or defective merchandise within 120 calendar days from the transaction date. Documentation including receipts, cancellation confirmation, and merchant communication logs must be submitted.

A provisional credit will be credited to the customer account within 10 business days for disputed billing amounts greater than $25. If the investigation resolves in favor of the merchant, the provisional credit will be revoked with a 10-day advance notification to the cardholder.
